standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 2489)

standard_prerequisites.name: The finiteness of Ext over a Noetherian ring between a finite module and a finite module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 2498)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the finiteness of the spectral sequence's E2 terms.

core_obligations: Unwind the statement: it is enough to show that for a bounded below complex K with finite cohomology modules the complex of derived internal homs into it has finite cohomology modules (proof lines 2487-2488)
Reduce to a finiteness claim: by the identification of the derived internal hom with Ext of the base ring, it is enough that the modules Ext^i_A(B, K) are finite over A (proof lines 2489-2491)

Compute through the spectral sequence: boundedness below gives a convergent spectral sequence whose E2 terms are the Ext groups of the cohomology modules of K, which are finite by the cited finiteness statement, and whose abutment is Ext of the original complex; hence the abutment is finite (proof lines 2491-2498)
proof_roadmap: 把结论展开为：K 下界、上同调有限 ⇒ RHom(B,K) 的上同调有限。
由 RHom-ext 引理把 RHom(B,K) 的系数换成 Ext_A^i(B,K)，问题化为 Ext_A^i(B,K) 有限。
K 有下界 ⇒ 收敛谱序列 Ext^p_A(B,H^q(K)) ⇒ Ext^{p+q}_A(B,K)，其 E2 项因 B 有限、H^q(K) 有限而有限（引用 Algebra 的有限性引理），故收尾项有限。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a finite ring map A -> B of Noetherian rings the functor R Hom(B, -) maps the bounded below complexes with finite cohomology modules over A into those over B (author lemma at source lines 2479-2484, label lemma-exact-support-coherent). The proof (source lines 2486-2499) reduces to the finiteness of the Ext modules Ext^i_A(B, K) through the identification of the derived internal hom with Ext, then exhibits a convergent spectral sequence computing those Ext modules from Ext^p_A(B, H^q(K)), whose terms are finite by the cited finiteness statement, so the abutment is finite. The reduction and the spectral sequence argument are the substance. H3.
